lines.zh: 我四脚走着，头顶的冠很高。
lines.en: I walk on four legs with a tall crest.

lines.zh: 森林里的树差不多跟我一样高。
lines.en: The trees here stand about as tall as me.
Three or four of us walk together.

lines.zh: 冠在我头上随着步子晃。
lines.en: The crest rocks with my stride.
Fallen fruit splits underfoot.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰同伴的背。
lines.en: I touch a herd-mate's back with my snout.
I remember the water here.
The thicket ahead must be skirted.

lines.zh: 我们走过的地方草压成一条。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a line where we pass.

lines.zh: 阳光从枝叶缝里漏下来。
lines.en: Sun leaks through the canopy.
I walk step by step toward lower ground.

lines.zh: 队伍里有只小的，走得慢。
lines.en: One of the young walks slowly.

lines.zh: 我们的冠在树影里很显眼。
lines.en: Our crests stand out against the tree shadows.
I walk at the back of the group.
I stand with my crest to the sun.
The wood is strangely quiet.
I lower my head and chew a little.
A herd-mate stands to one side.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，从冠里吹出声。
lines.en: I lift my head and blow a note through the crest.
Low and long-drawn.
A herd-mate answers.
The sound turns between the trunks.

lines.zh: 这片林子我知道有多大。
lines.en: I know how far this wood runs.
I push a low branch aside with my crest.
It sounds like blowing.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子往土里探了探。
lines.en: I probe the soil with my snout.
Damp; roots below.

lines.zh: 我把冠靠在一根树干上。
lines.en: I rest my crest against a trunk.
You stand on the other side of a tree.

lines.zh: 我们的冠大概比你还高。
lines.en: Our crests likely stand above you.

lines.zh: 我的头冠朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My crest points straight at you.
We are not trying to take it.
Do not stand in front of the young.
Step back over that way.
Your hands are empty.
Then we will stand.
You push your hat back.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在树影里发暗。
lines.en: My crest darkens in the tree shade.
We stand a little taller than you.
You look closely at the crest.

lines.zh: 头冠里的气一下子泄了。
lines.en: The air in my crest rushed out at once.
The herd circles round me.
There is a split in the crest.
I can still walk.
I shift slowly to a tree.
The skin along my crest is split.
I breathe with my head low.
It bleeds under my crest.
I brace the crest against a tree.
I turn the wound against a trunk.
That is fruit in your hand.
It smells quite ripe.
Set it upon the ground.
Several of us have smelled it.
You hold the fruit a little high.
I must lower my head to reach.
Your arm is tiring.
Lower it, then.

lines.zh: 你把它放在一块石头上。
lines.en: You set it on a stone.
That stone is too slick.
You hit my foreleg.
I bring all four feet to a stop.
The herd stopped too.

lines.zh: 你从我们中间穿了过去。
lines.en: You passed through the middle of us.
You are blocked by our legs.
The left side would be easier.
We shifted past each other.
I did not tread on you.

lines.zh: 你贴着我们走了一段路。
lines.en: You walked close beside us a while.
You went around to our front.

lines.zh: 我们群里的伴是从小一起的。
lines.en: Our mates have been with us since youth.
Those outside the herd do not count.

lines.zh: 我们这季已经成了两对。
lines.en: Two pairs have already formed this season.
I have no mate beside me.
That waits until the herd breaks up.
You ask too quickly.

lines.zh: 我们的伴是跟着群走的。
lines.en: Our mates come with the herd.
The herd arranges it.
I have other things to see to.
I cannot answer that.
A fruit has fallen on the ground.

lines.zh: 我这冠子一响，整群都听见。
lines.en: One note from my crest and the herd hears.
It tastes a little sour.
I still finish it.
It rolled under a root.
I reached it with my snout.
I watch you while I chew.
I sweep it to my feet with my beak.
Two more lie on the ground.
I ate those as well.
Something moves at the far end of the wood.

lines.zh: 我抬头，冠对着那个方向。
lines.en: I raise my head, crest toward it.
The herd spreads a little.
Our call carries far.
You hear one long note.
That was not for you.

lines.zh: 我用头冠吹出一声低鸣。
lines.en: I blow a low note through my crest.
The note from my crest runs long.
That was for my herd.
They are gathering this way.
Our numbers will grow.
Best you go now.
I push the young behind me.
They hide in the brush.
I walk step by step, not fast.
You are behind the tree at my flank.
My head rides a little above the trees.
I can see your shadow.
Do not stir just yet.
Move again and I will call.
I walk with my body turned.
This angle is to see you clearly.
A herd-mate is on my other side.

lines.zh: 森林里，我们三只围成一半圆。
lines.en: In the forest, three of us make a half circle.
You retreat behind a fallen log.
That log will not stop me.
I count your steps behind a tree.
One, two, and then three.
You have not changed direction.
We spread slowly to both sides.
The middle way is left for you.

lines.zh: 我的头冠先撞上你的肩。
lines.en: My crest hits your shoulder first.
My foreleg hits your shoulder.
The crest sweeps over.
You are shoved several steps back.
I turn myself back around.
This is hard on both of us.
I plant my forelegs and turn into you.
The crest sweeps past your head.
You are knocked sideways.
I shove with my shoulder again.
You are pushed into the grass.
You rise slowly.

lines.zh: 我的头顶到你的时候，你没退。
lines.en: You did not back off when my head reached you.
That one had real weight.
One note from my crest and the herd moves.
I come in from the flank.
There is moss on the forest floor.

lines.zh: 我们从树的间隙里走出来。
lines.en: We come out through a gap in the trees.
What shows first is the crest.
Three of us in all.
The fruit here has ripened.
Our steps are heavy.
A flock of birds takes off.
I look up at them.
They are afraid of us.
I snap a dead branch underfoot.
It echoes loudly in the wood.
I pause once.

lines.zh: 有一根树干被我们撞歪。
lines.en: One trunk stands askew where we struck it.
The leaf litter is deep.
We make no sound on it.
I raise my head and sniff.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的冠，我晃了晃头。
lines.en: Fire catches my crest and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，冠先磕在树上。
lines.en: I fall and the crest strikes a tree first.

lines.zh: 水到了我的胸口，我朝浅处走。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I head for the shallows.
The blast swirls the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的身侧。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks in my flank.
That light weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 饿的时候我连叫都叫不响。
lines.en: When hungry, I cannot even call loudly.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的冠上，声音很尖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crest with a sharp crack.
The moss beneath me is gone.
